chunks.text:

Physical Quantity; Kinematics; Dynamics; Energy; Rotational motion; Gravitation; Structure and Properties of Matter; Elasticity; Viscosity; Surface tension.

Heat and temperature; Transmission of heat; Basic assumption of kinetic theory of gases; Thermodynamics.

Reflection; Refraction; Speed of light; Dispersion of light; Optical Instrument; Photometry.

chunks.heading: Syllabus for Physics > D. Waves
chunks.text:

Wave motion; Sound; Electromagnetic waves.

Simple Electrostatic Phenomenon; Charge flow; Resistance; Effect of Current; Capacitors.

Magnetic field; Force on conductor; Magnetic materials; Electromagnetic induction; Alternating current.

Electron; Photons; Electronic; Atoms; Nucleus; Radioactivity; Elementary particles.

chunks.heading: Syllabus for Chemistry > A. General and Physical Chemistry
chunks.text:
Syllabus for Chemistry > A. General and Physical Chemistry
Language of Chemistry; Gaseous state of matter; Liquid state of matter; Solid state of matter; Laws of Stoichiometry; Avogadro's Hypothesis and its important applications; Atomic structure; Quantum numbers; Chemical bonding; Oxidation and Reduction; Acids, Bases and Salts; Acidimetry and Alkalimetry; Periodic Table; Electrochemistry; Electrode potential; Chemical Kinetics; Chemical Equilibrium; LeChatelier's Principle; Chemical Thermodynamics; Entropy and spontaneity.

chunks.text:

Hydrogen, Oxygen and Nitrogen; Carbon; Sulphur and its compound; Halogen and halogen acids; Introduction to Metals; Alkali and alkaline earth metals; Coinage metals; Heavy metals.

chunks.text:

Introduction to Organic Chemistry; Hydrocarbons; Organic halogen compounds; Alcohols; Ethers; Carbonyl Compounds; Carboxylic Acids; Amines; Aromatic Hydrocarbons; Aniline and Nitrobenzene; Carbohydrates, Proteins, Nucleic Acids, Lipids; Polymers, Pesticides, Dyes and Drugs.
